responsibility: Defines the mutable semantic-analysis scope record used while walking and type-checking D code. `Scope` carries the current module, symbol scope, enclosing function/statement context, loop/switch/try labels, template-instantiation state, constructor flow flags, alignment/linkage/visibility/storage-class attributes, deprecation and user-attribute state, documentation anchors, and lookup helper, making it the central thread of contextual information consumed by semantic passes.
